5.7 GBD panel (final).
The 20 GBD 2023 Level 3 causes of the panel in rank order of global DALY counts 2023, selected by the rule of 5.2 and mapped by the rule of 5.3 by IE and WP. The query expression is used verbatim as {G} in families GA, GD and GE. Members that coincide with a named field share its registered cells and are not queried again. Descriptors introduced after 2015 enter 2024 and the pooled windows only (panel rule of Q13). Scope relation: exact, broader or narrower than the GBD cause, or mixed where over- and under-inclusion are both stated.
